notes: [New] Agent-ready CMS: every capability lands MCP, then files/CLI, then REST, then console.
[New] MCP server (POST /mcp) with 12 tools, from shio_context to shio_verify.
[New] Claude Code plugin with the shio-site, shio-content-model and shio-verify skills.
[New] Agent gateway (/api/v2/agent/**): manifest, context pack, planned batches and a review queue.
[New] Teaching errors: every 4xx carries fix, allowed, didYouMean and example.
[New] Content as files: the site projected to Markdown on disk, with a three-way merge back.
[New] The shio CLI (@viglet/shio): pull, push, apply, publish, verify, clone, convert and more.
[New] Content Delivery API (/api/v2/cda/**): REST and GraphQL reads with zero-dependency TypeScript SDKs.
[New] npm create @viglet/shio-app: build a front end in JavaScript with no Java.
[New] Replicate an existing website with shio clone and shio convert.
[New] Universal Editor, review queue and preview links in the console.
[New] Docker image ghcr.io/openviglet/shio, with SHIO_ADMIN_PASSWORD for a scriptable first start.
[Improved] React console replaces the AngularJS one, with 15 form widgets.
[Improved] Liquibase schema, proved on PostgreSQL and MariaDB by containerized integration tests.
[Improved] Response sizes are a measured token budget asserted in CI.
[Improved] Code Smell and Bugs were fixed
[Improved] Import check if package has posts.
[New] Product name was changed to Shio.
[New] Commit Git Commit Id on Version.
[New] Import Dialog to use Exchange Provider.
[Improved] Pre-Upload: Check if the file exists.
[Improved] Sample Site with new Post Type Association JSON.
[Improved] Sync Nested Attributes PostType into Post.
[Improved] Tomcat Special chars and removed System msgs.
[New] Export Post Types from Post Type Page Layout as dependency.
[Improved] Reference JSON and it shows Javascript Code error into logs.
[Improved] Delete old reference before update Post.
[Improved] Removed UI Local Files, using submodule shiohara-ui.
[New] Turing Semantic Navigation Settings into Post Type.
[Improved] Download Site Button into Object List View.
[New] Show content files from /sites URL: Response file with mime type.
[New] Viglet Turing Integration: Indexing Posts in Semantic Navigation.
[New] InContext Editing using Float Menu to Regions.
[New] Site Form: Create Forms into Site and save as Posts into Shiohara CMS.
[New] Site Template: Create a new site using template
[New] Clone Site: Clone a site with different Ids.
[New] In-Context Editing: New toolbar in Preview Site, that allows edit the content directly.
[New] Default Folder Page Layout: Create a empty Folder using default Page Layout.
[New] Relator: Create fields as children of parent field.
[New] Sort: Drag and Drop Folders and Posts to reorder into /content, this change will reflect Navigation and Query Component order.
[Improved] New Post Type Editor: Edit Fields of Post Types in same window without pop up. Using accordion component encapsulate entire fields details
[New] Search: You can search for objects into /content
[New] Content Select Widget: Create a Post Type field that allows elect some post
[New] File Widget: Create a Post Type field that allows select some File.
[Improved] Removed GlobalId because Posts, Folders and Sites Ids are unique
